main_measure.name: mean 10-bar excess forward return after forecast >= 10, pooled, non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 non-overlapping cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess rises across in-regime forecast buckets [0,5), [5,10), >=10 (value: top minus bottom bucket mean)

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2 with at least 30 cases, so it neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: Cases are the bars at positions 0, 10, 20, ... of each window, and the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken over that same grid pooled across all its windows; the buckets are half-open [0,5), [5,10), >=10 on mean_reversion-regime bars including zero forecasts; and the supporting check passes when the three bucket means strictly increase and does not enter the decision.
